versions.content: Timestamp not provided via event reporting interface If the timestamp feature is enabled and the SEv is reported without a timestamp parameter via the services IdsM_SetSecurityEventWithTimestampCount or IdsM_Set- SecurityEventWithTimestampCountContextData , then IdsM shall set the op- tion bit for the time stamp in protocol header to 0 before the transmission or storage of the QSEv .
